session.instructions:
An original adult female voice in her mid-twenties, speaking native standard Japanese. Radiant, glamorous, honey-warm mid register with a relaxed, languid, affectionately coaxing drawl. Lush and silky timbre, unhurried tempo, softly elongated vowels and a breathy, playful sweet-spoiled lilt at the ends of phrases, effortlessly charming and at ease.
Speak immediately in Japanese. Say exactly this line once: "きゃあっ……ま、待って……ああっ……！". Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, or add words. Then remain silent. Delivery direction: Sudden high-intensity startled cry of shock and overwhelming emotion, breathless and trembling, dramatic anime voice acting. No music or background noise. Enunciate every syllable clearly and remain silent immediately after finishing.
